items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: He was around there. All these people were downtown. Down there big clubs and things. All the big dance halls downtown. All these boys were downtown. He lived once over the river where he was at.

ctx.x: and they get the planes on their planes and their planes and their planes and their planes You used to go to watch and some people used to do their best defense, take a prize degree, and then they just, you see the joke there. Yeah? How about that? They just never shoot. Just like a feeling.

They had a real nice, nice birthday out there. They had a real stage there. And the orchestra was down in the, you know, in front of the pit. Yeah, the pit down there and stayed up above them. They stayed down there. You turned to the link up there? Yeah. Was the Johnson part the same way? No, no, no. I never had no show. Would you say Buddy Baldwin was a big name too? Oh yeah, before he was shot down there. I remember him. Yeah. All that clear. Do you remember when he went crazy? Do you remember him going crazy?…
Yeah, what did he start to do when he went crazy? Did you know?
